_comment: Weekly question-bank scraper sources. Enable a source by setting "enabled": true. The workflow runs every Monday 03:00 UTC (edit .github/workflows/scrape-weekly.yml for frequency). Everything scraped lands as DRAFT in the Admin → Question bank → review & publish. Types: "json" (array or {questions|items|data: [...]}), "html", "markdown" (both use question-marker heuristics).

sources.note: Items may override fieldId/level; otherwise these defaults apply.
